reviews.title: This is a great buy!
reviews.comment: This monitor is amazing. I got it for my wife so she had a touchscreen to use with her games. The setup was super simple, the included cables were perfect and only took a few minutes and works great. The speakers are adequate for gaming and Discord. The picture is so good, especially for as inexpensive as this monitor is. My wife has cararacts and had a hard time with her old monitor, this one she can see the screen very well. The touch screen is very responsive.
reviews.author: Kristin C.

reviews.title: Love my new monitor!
reviews.comment: I have loved this portable monitor so far! The picture is so clear and the touch screen has the perfect amount of sensitivity. The setup was so easy and it was instantly compatible. It came with all the chords you would need and I was surprised to see it also came with a case for protection. I am able to work at coffee shops so Much easier now and it’s so light weight and easy to transport. I’m very happy with my purchase!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great for Stationary and Travel Use
reviews.comment:
I recently replaced my old MacBook Pro with a new Mac Mini M4 Pro as my main workstation.  I already had an external UHD monitor connected to that laptop, so I needed a small monitor to replace the 16" one that was built in to that laptop.  Not only is this monitor perfect for my use, but the touchscreen capability is a bonus!  The glass panel and thin bezels look great and the monitor is the perfect size to replace the screen I had before.  I wasn't expecting the touchscreen function to work with my Mac but it does.  If this were the only monitor connected to my Mac, it would work completely as expected for single-taps, but when the Mac has multiple monitors and is set to "extend" across monitors, the touchscreen function works as expected but only when the cursor is already on this 16" monitor.  I can accept that because everything else is great - especially for the price.  This monitor is also great for use as a temporary or mobile monitor for my iPhone and iPad.  The touchscreen functions don't work with them, but this is still a great 16" screen for my phone and tablet.  Another surprise is that the monitor's built-in menu system works with the touchscreen function so you don't have to mess around with funky button combinations to adjust its brightness or volume settings.
This screen also has built-in speakers that aren't too bad, and works with HDR on my Mac mini and looks great when used in combination with my other external UHD monitor.
The multi-position kickstand supports the screen well even when poking at it with your fingers, and stores discretely when not needed.  One of the few small suggested improvements would be to add rubber "feet" closer to the middle edge of the screen to support using the monitor on narrower surfaces like small tray tables on a plane or train, etc...
This screen also comes with a neoprene sleeve for travel and storage.  While it works as intended, I would have liked a folio-style case that remains attached to the screen a little better.  Not a deal-breaker as I don't plan on traveling much with this screen and when I do, the included sleeve will provide good protection.  It's just not as convenient as an attached folio-style would have been.
BTW, a ton of cables were included for nearly all connection scenarios.  A USB power adapter was also supplied if needed to power the screen separately.
Overall, a great screen and a great value!
reviews.author: S. Leapman

reviews.title: Good price, easy fit in bag, cord options included
reviews.comment: PhD student here so spend A LOT of time needing multiple screens for research and the ability to see with clarity and ease. I also need a screen that is easy to fit in my book bag for easy transport. I've been incredibly happy with the CAPERAVE touchscreen monitor on all counts. My eyes are tired from the reading so I like the resolution as well as the ability to dim and brighten with ease. Additionally, I have a Microsoft Surface Pro, Mac laptop , and HP laptop to use depending on if I'm working from home or the office. The multiple cords provided insure I have the connector options I need for each situation. I especially love the touchscreen option for quick scrolling and link selection. My son also loves sneaking the screen away when I'm not looking to connect to his Nintendo Switch. This is a great screen, def recommend!
reviews.author: Rusty Woods

reviews.title: Genuinely useful second screen if your setup supports it
reviews.comment:
I bought this portable touchscreen monitor a while back and I’m still using it regularly, which says a lot because most tech “helpers” end up in a drawer. For my everyday laptop setup it’s been a solid upgrade. The 15.6 inch size is the sweet spot where it actually feels like a real second screen, but it’s still easy to toss in a bag. The picture is crisp for 1080p, viewing angles are good, and the touchscreen is more than a gimmick. It’s great for quick taps, scrolling, and basic controls when you’re working with multiple windows.
The biggest thing I’d tell anyone is to use the cables that come in the box. That sounds obvious, but it matters here. I tried using a couple of my own USB C cables and an older HDMI cable and that’s when I saw little issues like the screen not waking properly or the connection acting finicky. Switching back to the included wires fixed it immediately and it’s been reliable since.
What really makes this worth it for me is that if you set it up correctly, you usually don’t need an extra power source. In the right setup it can run off your main device power, so you’re not dragging around another brick or hunting for an outlet. That keeps everything clean and portable, especially when you're on the go. When it’s working that way, it feels like the monitor is just an extension of your laptop instead of another device you have to babysit.
I wouldn’t say it’s a perfect fit for every situation, because it depends on what you’re plugging it into and what your ports support, but for the way I use it it’s been genuinely useful and absolutely worth the money. If you want a portable second screen that you’ll actually keep using, this one does the job.
reviews.author: SiliconSorcerer
